title: A revised booking implies a different delivery date

correspondence.subject: ELW-619 test dossier courier booking
correspondence.body: The laboratory has reserved the courier for the ELW-619 water-quality test dossier. We can deliver the complete dossier on 24 April 2027 once the final cultures have been checked. Please arrange reception cover for that delivery rather than the earlier slot in the programme. Kind regards, Saira

requirements.name: Water-quality test dossier
requirements.description: Deliver the complete laboratory water-quality test dossier.
